Staffed with senior pilots and accomplished instructors, we bring a wealth of experience and diverse flying backgrounds. Our clients come to us for the well-rounded options and speciality work that we can provide, and in turn we have developed strong partnerships and loyal clientele. blurb: Helicopters Canada offers personalized and customizable flight training programs with over 200 hours of formal in-class ground school. Students receive extensive training and operational courses to prepare for a career in aviation. The Duty Pilot Program prepares students for life in the industry by putting them in charge of organizing and overseeing flight operations.
